role: verdict audit — operator approval list consistency
assignment: Check census/round-3/operator-approval-list.tsv: all 96 data-row paths still exist; run tools/souji-verify.sh on first, last, and six random physical data-line numbers and expect SAFE(pushed).
verdict: AGREE with round-3 approval-list claim on this audit: all 96 paths exist; sample 8/8 independently re-verify SAFE(pushed); no defect found.

agreement.round3_claim: ../.ufo/reports/round-3/souji.md, Before → after measurements: 96 unique approve-remove rows, all SAFE/pushed, 0 false-SAFE
agreement.scope_note: Only the required eight-row SAFE(pushed) sample was re-verified; this does not claim all 96 rows were re-run through the verifier.

sample.selection: Physical line 2 (first data row), line 97 (last data row), plus six unique random physical line numbers selected with shuf -i 3-96 -n 6.

commands.command: python3 -c 'import csv, pathlib, sys; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); rows=list(csv.DictReader(p.open(), delimiter="\t")); missing=[r["path"] for r in rows if not pathlib.Path(r["path"]).exists()]; print(f"data_rows={len(rows)} existing={len(rows)-len(missing)} missing={len(missing)}"); print("missing=" + repr(missing))' census/round-3/operator-approval-list.tsv

set -euo pipefail
file=census/round-3/operator-approval-list.tsv
mapfile -t samples < <({ printf '2\n97\n'; shuf -i 3-96 -n 6; } | sort -n)
printf 'selected_physical_line_numbers=%s\n' "${samples[*]}"
passed=0
for n in "${samples[@]}"; do
  path=$(awk -F '\t' -v n="$n" 'NR==n { print $1 }' "$file")
  printf 'sample_line_%s_path=%s\n' "$n" "$path"
  out=$(tools/souji-verify.sh "$path")
  printf '%s\n' "$out"
  IFS=$'\t' read -r tag reported verdict receipt evidence <<< "$out"
  if [[ "$tag" != VERDICT || "$reported" != "$path" || "$verdict" != SAFE || "$receipt" != pushed ]]; then
    printf 'sample_line_%s_check=FAIL\n' "$n"
    exit 1
  fi
  passed=$((passed + 1))
done
printf 'sample_results=%s/8 SAFE(pushed)\n' "$passed"
